def merge_sorted_list(list1, list2, list3):
    """
    Merges three input lists into a single sorted list in ascending order.
    
    Args:
        list1 (list): First list of integers.
        list2 (list): Second list of integers.
        list3 (list): Third list of integers.
        
    Returns:
        list: A new list containing all elements from the three inputs, sorted.
    """
    # Unpack the lists and pass them to the built-in sorted function
    return sorted(list1 + list2 + list3)

# Test case as provided in your request
if __name__ == "__main__":
    result = merge_sorted_list([25, 24, 15, 4, 5, 29, 110], [19, 20, 11, 56, 25, 233, 154], [24, 26, 54, 48])
    expected = [4, 5, 11, 15, 19, 20, 24, 24, 25, 25, 26, 29, 48, 54, 56, 110, 154, 233]
    
    assert result == expected, f"Expected {expected}, but got {result}"
    print("Test passed successfully!")
